讨个说法（讨个说法（第22页）这是素心真人此生第一次见到云祈仙心绪不宁到了这个程度。她的神识碰见云祈仙的时候，外面像是碰见了薄霜，而这层霜的深处，宛若一锅沸腾的烫得人心惊的水。“仙儿，你”素心真人伸出手掌，想要去握住云祈仙那冰凉僵硬的手。然而触碰到云祈仙肌肤的刹那，素心一震，如触电般收回手。云祈仙终于醒了醒神，好似经历了一场脱力的梦。“对不起……师尊。”她垂下的眸子中，似有一层如仙似幻的光轮一闪而逝，素心未曾看清，顿了顿神，只听云祈仙的声音一如往常般，清冷如玉碎。“我会去向他问个说法。”她的声音似乎听不出有太大的异常，又像压抑着什么。“不，你不能去，这不是你可以参与的事。”素心真人神情严肃起来。“仙儿，我们长老自有定夺，此事非比寻常，你先回去闭关，用清心咒。”素心真人生怕云祈仙干出些不理智的事来，又问了几声，才让云祈仙点头应是，只是她依旧垂着眸，让素心有些忧虑。“你明白就好。”素心见云祈仙转身，朝着剑阁深处一步步走去，松了口气。她无比知晓云祈仙此时的心情。目睹这样的场景，那样一个与她牵绊如此之多的男子，当着他的面，一剑枭首了她弟弟，甚至还可能屠戮她飞雪岛百名弟子，与雪崖剑阁立下不共戴天之仇。这世上再无情冷漠之人，都不可能再如寻常。与寻常人相比，云祈仙已经算得上冷静，她这弟子从小也未让她操心过，性情冷淡而听话，或许她闭关之后会好上一些。至少绝不能让她去寻裴苏，谁知道那位世子还会不会动杀戒忽然，云祈仙停下了脚步，素心一震，便见她微微侧了侧身，顿了一下，似有什么话要说，最后却什么都没说，下一刻竟刹那间化为一道清冷剑光冲天而去，没有打半分招呼。这还是平生第一次，云祈仙如此直白的违逆她的话。甚至叫素心真人都没来得及反应，但下一刻，她咬牙伸出了手。她欲施展神通将云祈仙强行拦下，但——“素心长老！”几个长老同时发声将她打断，素心转头，瞧见了那几位剑阁长老的眼神，带着制止，带着压抑的冷色。素心沉默，她自然知道这些长老的算盘。此事太过惊骇恐怖，不出许久，飞雪岛惨案足以传遍整个宗门甚至是南境。雪崖剑阁绝不可能对此事彻底装聋作哑、略过不提，其严重程度还要远超当年的太皓之死，更何况，如此真凶几乎就摆在他们的眼前。但他们剑阁真的敢大张旗鼓地去裴家兴师问罪吗？无人胆敢回答这个问题。如此一来，与裴苏关系曾经最为亲近的云祈仙，便成了眼下最好、也是唯一的选择，至少无论如何，他们要从那位高贵世子讨一个说法。如果事实是裴苏无缘无故残害他剑阁弟子，即便他们无法对付裴苏，也要让此事传遍天下，让其声名受累，被天下正道讨伐！

Let me give you an explanation (Let me give you an explanation (page 22)) This is the first time in her life that Su Xin has seen Yun Qixian so uneasy. When her consciousness met Yun Qixian, the outside seemed to be covered with thin frost, and the depth of this frost was like a pot of boiling hot water. "Xian'er, you" Su Xin held out her palm, trying to hold Yun Qixian's cold and stiff hand. However, the moment she touched Yun Qixian's skin, , Su's heart was shocked, and she retracted her hand as if she was electrocuted. Yun Qixian finally woke up, as if she had experienced a debilitating dream. "I'm sorry... Master." There seemed to be a layer of fairy-like light in her lowered eyes. It flashed by, and Su Xin didn't see it clearly. She paused and heard Yun Qixian's voice as cold as ever, "I will ask him for an explanation." There seemed to be nothing unusual in her voice. What is suppressing. "No, you can't go, this is not something you can participate in." Master Su Xin looked serious. "Xian'er, our elders have made their own decisions. This matter is unusual. You should go back to retreat first and use the Qingxin Curse." Master Su Xin was afraid that Yun Qixian would do something irrational, so he asked a few more times before Yun Qixian nodded in agreement, but she still lowered her eyes, which made Su Xin a little worried. "Just understand." Seeing Yun Qixian turn around and walk towards the depths of the sword pavilion, she was very aware of Yun Qixian's mood at this time. Seeing such a scene, such a man who had so many ties to her, killed her brother with a sword in front of him, and even killed a hundred of her disciples on Feixue Island, and established a sworn enemy with Xueya sword pavilion. Yun Qixian is already considered calm. Her disciple has never let her worry about her since she was a child. She has a cold and obedient temperament. Maybe she will be better after seclusion. At least she will not be allowed to look for Pei Su. Who knows if the prince will kill him? Daoqing's cold sword light shot up into the sky without saying a word of greeting. This was the first time in her life that Yun Qixian violated her words so bluntly. Even Su Xin had no time to react, but the next moment, she gritted her teeth and stretched out her hand. She wanted to use her magical power to stop Yun Qixian, but - "Elder Su Xin!" Several elders interrupted her at the same time. Su Xin turned her head and saw the eyes of the elders of the sword pavilion. With a suppressed cold expression, Su Xin was silent. She naturally knew what these elders were planning. This matter was too shocking and terrifying. Soon, the tragedy of Feixue Island would spread throughout the entire sect and even the southern region. It was impossible for Xueya Jiange to completely ignore it and ignore it. It was far more serious than Tai Hao's death. What's more, such a real murderer was almost in front of them. But they Jiange really dared to go to Pei in a big way. Do you think Jiaxingshi is guilty? No one dares to answer this question. In this way, Yun Qixian, who was once the closest to Pei Su, has become the best and only choice. At least no matter what, they want to get an explanation from the noble prince.
